```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

# Load the data
off_outcome <- fread("processed_predict_ccafd_off_grades.csv.csv.gz")
off_select <- fread("processed_predict_ccfd_off_grades.csv.csv.gz")
def_outcome <- fread("processed_predict_ccafd_def_grades.csv.csv.gz")
def_select <- fread("processed_predict_ccfd_def_grades.csv.csv.gz")

# Function to transform column names
transform_column_names <- function(df) {
  # Position mapping with individual positions
  offense_positions <- c(
    # QB slots (1-3)
    "1" = "QB", "2" = "QB2", "3" = "QB3",
    # Backs slots (4-7)
    "4" = "RB", "5" = "RB2", "6" = "FB", "7" = "FB2",
    # Wide receivers slots (8-13)
    "8" = "WR1", "9" = "WR2", "10" = "WR3", "11" = "WR4", "12" = "WR5", "13" = "WR6",
    # Tight ends slots (14-16)
    "14" = "TE1", "15" = "TE2", "16" = "TE3",
    # Offensive line slots (17-24)
    "17" = "OL1", "18" = "OL2", "19" = "OL3", "20" = "OL4", "21" = "OL5", 
    "22" = "OL6", "23" = "OL7", "24" = "OL8"
  )
  
  defense_positions <- c(
    # Defensive line slots (1-8)
    "1" = "DL1", "2" = "DL2", "3" = "DL3", "4" = "DL4", 
    "5" = "DL5", "6" = "DL6", "7" = "DL7", "8" = "DL8",
    # Linebackers slots (9-14)
    "9" = "LB1", "10" = "LB2", "11" = "LB3", "12" = "LB4", 
    "13" = "LB5", "14" = "LB6",
    # Cornerbacks slots (15-19)
    "15" = "CB1", "16" = "CB2", "17" = "CB3", "18" = "CB4", "19" = "CB5",
    # Safeties slots (20-23)
    "20" = "S1", "21" = "S2", "22" = "S3", "23" = "S4"
  )
  
  # Get column names
  cols <- colnames(df)
  new_cols <- cols
  
  for (i in seq_along(cols)) {
    col <- cols[i]
    
    # Special handling for missing_information columns
    if (grepl("_missing_information$", col)) {
      if (grepl("offense_player_", col)) {
        player_num <- gsub(".*offense_player_([0-9]+)_missing_information$", "\\1", col)
        if (player_num %in% names(offense_positions)) {
          position <- offense_positions[player_num]
          new_cols[i] <- ifelse(grepl("^starter_", col),
                               paste0("starter_", position, "_missing_information"),
                               paste0(position, "_missing_information"))
        }
      } else if (grepl("defense_player_", col)) {
        player_num <- gsub(".*defense_player_([0-9]+)_missing_information$", "\\1", col)
        if (player_num %in% names(defense_positions)) {
          position <- defense_positions[player_num]
          new_cols[i] <- ifelse(grepl("^starter_", col),
                               paste0("starter_", position, "_missing_information"),
                               paste0(position, "_missing_information"))
        }
      }
      next
    }
    
    # Handle offense player patterns
    if (grepl("offense_player_", col)) {
      player_num <- gsub(".*offense_player_([0-9\\-]+).*", "\\1", col)
      
      # Determine position
      if (grepl("-", player_num)) {
        range_parts <- strsplit(player_num, "-")[[1]]
        if (length(range_parts) == 2) {
          start_num <- as.numeric(range_parts[1])
          if (start_num >= 17 && start_num <= 24) {
            position <- paste0("OL", start_num - 16)
          } else {
            position <- paste0("OFF", player_num)
          }
        } else {
          position <- paste0("OFF", player_num)
        }
      } else if (player_num %in% names(offense_positions)) {
        position <- offense_positions[player_num]
      } else {
        position <- paste0("OFF", player_num)
      }
      
      # Replace pattern and remove first two words after
      if (grepl("^starter_", col)) {
        parts <- strsplit(gsub("starter_offense_player_[0-9\\-]+_", "", col), "_")[[1]]
        if (length(parts) >= 2) {
          parts <- parts[-(1:2)]
        }
        new_cols[i] <- paste("starter", position, paste(parts, collapse = "_"), sep = "_")
      } else {
        parts <- strsplit(gsub("offense_player_[0-9\\-]+_", "", col), "_")[[1]]
        if (length(parts) >= 2) {
          parts <- parts[-(1:2)]
        }
        new_cols[i] <- paste(position, paste(parts, collapse = "_"), sep = "_")
      }
    }
    
    # Handle defense player patterns
    else if (grepl("defense_player_", col)) {
      player_num <- gsub(".*defense_player_([0-9]+).*", "\\1", col)
      
      if (player_num %in% names(defense_positions)) {
        position <- defense_positions[player_num]
      } else {
        position <- paste0("DEF", player_num)
      }
      
      if (grepl("^starter_", col)) {
        parts <- strsplit(gsub("starter_defense_player_[0-9]+_", "", col), "_")[[1]]
        if (length(parts) >= 2) {
          parts <- parts[-(1:2)]
        }
        new_cols[i] <- paste("starter", position, paste(parts, collapse = "_"), sep = "_")
      } else {
        parts <- strsplit(gsub("defense_player_[0-9]+_", "", col), "_")[[1]]
        if (length(parts) >= 2) {
          parts <- parts[-(1:2)]
        }
        new_cols[i] <- paste(position, paste(parts, collapse = "_"), sep = "_")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Set the new column names
  colnames(df) <- new_cols
  return(df)
}

# Function to extract year from my_id and create season indicators
process_dataset <- function(data) {
  # First transform column names
  dt <- transform_column_names(data)
  
  # Extract year from my_id (format: YYYY_XX_XXX_XXX_XXX)
  dt[, year := as.integer(substr(my_id, 1, 4))]
  
  # Create season indicator variables
  years <- sort(unique(dt$year))
  reference_year <- min(years)  # Use earliest year as reference
  
  for (yr in years) {
    if (yr != reference_year) {
      var_name <- paste0("season_", yr)
      dt[, (var_name) := as.integer(year == yr)]
    }
  }
  
  # Remove temporary year column
  dt[, year := NULL]
  
  # Remove team fixed effects (year*_team_*)
  team_fe_cols <- grep("^year.*_team_", names(dt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(team_fe_cols) > 0) {
    dt[, (team_fe_cols) := NULL]
  }
  
  # Remove coach columns (FirstName_LastName pattern)
  coach_cols <- names(dt)[grep("^[A-Z][a-z]+_[A-Z][a-z]+$", names(dt))]
  if (length(coach_cols) > 0) {
    dt[, (coach_cols) := NULL]
  }
  
  # Remove my_id after extracting year information
  dt[, my_id := NULL]
  
  # kill the cols taht contain the words missing_information 
  dt[, grep("missing_information", names(dt), value = TRUE) := NULL]
  
  return(dt)
}

# Process all datasets
off_outcome <- process_dataset(off_outcome)
off_select <- process_dataset(off_select)
def_outcome <- process_dataset(def_outcome)
def_select <- process_dataset(def_select)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)

# Assuming you've already run the preprocessing code from paste.txt:
# off_outcome, off_select, def_outcome, def_select are available

# Function to split data into regular and starter versions
split_regular_starter <- function(data) {
  # Make copies to work with
  regular_data <- copy(data)
  starter_data <- copy(data)
  
  # For regular data: Keep only non-starter columns
  starter_cols <- grep("^starter_", names(regular_data), value = TRUE)
  if (length(starter_cols) > 0) {
    regular_data[, (starter_cols) := NULL]
  }
  
  # For starter data: Keep only starter columns and shared columns
  # First, identify position-related columns that aren't starter columns
  position_prefixes <- c("QB", "QB[2-3]", "RB", "RB2", "FB", "FB2", 
                         "WR\\d+", "TE\\d+", "OL\\d+", 
                         "DL\\d+", "LB\\d+", "CB\\d+", "S\\d+")
  
  # Create regex pattern for position columns
  position_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(position_prefixes, collapse = "|"), ")_")
  
  # Find all position columns that are NOT starter columns
  player_cols <- grep(position_pattern, names(starter_data), value = TRUE)
  player_cols <- player_cols[!grepl("^starter_", player_cols)]
  
  # Remove non-starter position columns from starter data
  if (length(player_cols) > 0) {
    starter_data[, (player_cols) := NULL]
  }
  
  return(list(regular = regular_data, starter = starter_data))
}

# Split all datasets
off_outcome_split <- split_regular_starter(off_outcome)
off_select_split <- split_regular_starter(off_select)
def_outcome_split <- split_regular_starter(def_outcome)
def_select_split <- split_regular_starter(def_select)

# Extract the datasets
off_outcome_regular <- off_outcome_split$regular
off_outcome_starter <- off_outcome_split$starter

def_outcome_starter <- def_outcome_split$starter
#def_select_regular <- def_select_split$regular
def_select_starter <- def_select_split$starter
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(xgboost)
library(ROCR)
library(parallel)

# Function to run XGBoost grid search and testing on datasets
run_xgboost_analysis <- function(data, outcome_column = "conversion", 
                                 output_prefix = "model") {
  
  # Ensure outcome column is present
  if (!(outcome_column %in% names(data))) {
    stop(paste("Column", outcome_column, "not found in dataset"))
  }
  
  cat("\nRunning XGBoost analysis for", output_prefix, "on column", outcome_column, "\n")
  
  # Prepare the XGBoost matrices
  formula_str <- paste0("~ . - 1 - ", outcome_column)
  xs <- model.matrix(as.formula(formula_str), data = data)
  y <- as.numeric(as.character(data[[outcome_column]]))
  
  # Create parameter grid - EXACTLY as in original code
  grid <- expand.grid(
    eta = seq(0.001, 0.1, by = 0.001),
    max_depth = seq(3, 7, by = 1),
    min_child_weight = seq(1, 1, by = 1),        
    subsample = seq(0.8, 0.8, by = 0.2),
    colsample_bytree = seq(1, 1, by = 0.2),
    lambda = seq(1, 1, by = 1),                
    alpha = seq(0, 0, by = 1),                  
    gamma = seq(0, 0, by = 0.1),               
    nrounds = seq(150, 150, by = 50)  # Fixed 300 as upper limit
  )
  
  # Sample grid points
  conf_lev <- .95
  num_max <- 5
  n <- ceiling(log(1-conf_lev)/log(1-num_max/nrow(grid)))
  ind <- sample(nrow(grid), n, replace = FALSE)
  rgrid <- grid[ind, ]
  
  # Set up parallel processing
  nc <- detectCores() - 1
  
  # Calculate scale_pos_weight for imbalanced dataset
  scale_pos_weight <- sum(y == 0) / sum(y == 1)
  cat("Class imbalance (negative:positive):", scale_pos_weight, "\n")
  
  # Validation phase
  cat("\nPhase 1: Validation Phase\n")
  n_validations <- 20
  validation_results <- matrix(nrow = nrow(rgrid), ncol = n_validations)
  
  for (j in 1:nrow(rgrid)) {
    cat("\nTesting parameter set", j, "of", nrow(rgrid), "\n")
    
    for (i in 1:n_validations) {
      # Create validation split
      idx <- unique(sample(nrow(xs), nrow(xs), TRUE))
      train_x <- xs[idx, ]
      train_y <- y[idx]
      val_x <- xs[-idx, ]
      val_y <- y[-idx]
      
      prm <- list(
        booster = "gbtree",
        objective = "binary:logistic",
        max_depth = rgrid[j, "max_depth"],
        eta = rgrid[j, "eta"],
        subsample = rgrid[j, "subsample"],
        colsample_bytree = rgrid[j, "colsample_bytree"],
        gamma = rgrid[j, "gamma"],
        min_child_weight = rgrid[j, "min_child_weight"],
        alpha = rgrid[j, "alpha"],
        lambda = rgrid[j, "lambda"],
        scale_pos_weight = scale_pos_weight,
        nthread = nc
      )
      
      dm_train <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_x, label = train_y)
      mdl <- xgb.train(
        params = prm,
        data = dm_train,
        nrounds = rgrid[j, "nrounds"],
        verbose = FALSE
      )
      
      p <- predict(mdl, xgb.DMatrix(data = val_x))
      pred <- prediction(p, val_y)
      validation_results[j, i] <- performance(pred, "auc")@y.values[[1]]
    }
  }
  
  # Find best parameters
  mean_validation <- rowMeans(validation_results)
  best_params_idx <- which.max(mean_validation)
  best_params <- rgrid[best_params_idx,]
  
  # Display best parameters and validation performance
  cat("\nBest parameters found:\n")
  print(best_params)
  cat("Mean validation AUC:", mean_validation[best_params_idx], "\n")
  
  # Create parameter list for xgb.train
  best_params_list <- as.list(best_params[-which(names(best_params) == "nrounds")])
  best_params_list$booster <- "gbtree"
  best_params_list$objective <- "binary:logistic"
  best_params_list$scale_pos_weight <- scale_pos_weight
  best_params_list$nthread <- nc
  
  # Run test iterations with best parameters
  n_tests <- 1000
  cat("\nRunning", n_tests, "test iterations with best parameters...\n")
  test_aucs <- numeric(n_tests)
  
  for(i in 1:n_tests) {
    if(i %% 10 == 0) cat("\nTest iteration", i)
    
    # Create test split
    idx <- unique(sample(nrow(xs), nrow(xs), TRUE))
    train_x <- xs[idx, ]
    train_y <- y[idx]
    test_x <- xs[-idx, ]
    test_y <- y[-idx]
    
    # Train model on training set
    dm_train <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_x, label = train_y)
    mdl <- xgb.train(
      params = best_params_list,
      data = dm_train,
      nrounds = best_params[["nrounds"]],
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Test on test set
    p <- predict(mdl, xgb.DMatrix(data = test_x))
    pred <- prediction(p, test_y)
    test_aucs[i] <- performance(pred, "auc")@y.values[[1]]
  }
  
  # Print test results
  cat("\nTest Results over", n_tests, "iterations:\n")
  cat("Mean AUC:", mean(test_aucs), "\n")
  cat("SD AUC:", sd(test_aucs), "\n")
  cat("95% CI:", mean(test_aucs) - 1.96 * sd(test_aucs), 
      "to", mean(test_aucs) + 1.96 * sd(test_aucs), "\n")
  
  # Plot AUC distribution
  output_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_auc_distribution.png")
  png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600, res = 100)
  
  plot(test_aucs, col="red", pch=20,
       main=paste("AUC Test Distribution -", output_prefix),
       xlab="Iteration", ylab="AUC")
  abline(h=mean(test_aucs), col="blue", lwd=2, lty=2)  # Add line to show mean
  abline(h=mean(test_aucs) - 1.96 * sd(test_aucs), col="green", lwd=2, lty=3)
  abline(h=mean(test_aucs) + 1.96 * sd(test_aucs), col="green", lwd=2, lty=3)
  legend("bottomright", 
         legend=c("AUC Values", "Mean", "95% CI Bounds"),
         col=c("red", "blue", "green"),
         lty=c(NA, 2, 3),
         pch=c(20, NA, NA))
  
  dev.off()
  cat("\nPlot saved to", output_file, "\n")
  
  # Train final model on full dataset
  dm_full <- xgb.DMatrix(data = xs, label = y)
  final_model <- xgb.train(
    params = best_params_list,
    data = dm_full,
    nrounds = best_params[["nrounds"]],
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Save model and parameters
  model_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_model.rds")
  saveRDS(final_model, file = model_file)
  cat("Model saved to", model_file, "\n")
  
  params_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_best_params.csv")
  best_params_list$nrounds <- best_params[["nrounds"]]
  write.csv(as.data.frame(best_params_list), file = params_file, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Best parameters saved to", params_file, "\n")
  
  # Get variable importance
  importance <- xgb.importance(model = final_model)
  importance_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_importance.csv")
  write.csv(importance, file = importance_file, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Variable importance saved to", importance_file, "\n")
  
  # Return results
  return(list(
    model = final_model,
    best_params = best_params_list,
    test_aucs = test_aucs,
    importance = importance
  ))
}

# Apply function to each dataset
cat("\n\n========== RUNNING XGBOOST MODELS FOR ALL DATASETS ==========\n\n")

# Run for off_outcome_regular
cat("\n\n========== OFFENSIVE REGULAR OUTCOME MODEL ==========\n\n")
off_outcome_regular_results <- run_xgboost_analysis(
  data = off_outcome_regular,
  outcome_column = "conversion",
  output_prefix = "off_outcome_regular"
)

# Run for off_outcome_starter
cat("\n\n========== OFFENSIVE STARTER OUTCOME MODEL ==========\n\n")
off_outcome_starter_results <- run_xgboost_analysis(
  data = off_outcome_starter,
  outcome_column = "conversion",
  output_prefix = "off_outcome_starter"
)

# Run for off_select_starter
cat("\n\n========== OFFENSIVE STARTER SELECT MODEL ==========\n\n")
off_select_starter_results <- run_xgboost_analysis(

  output_prefix = "off_select_starter"
)

# Run for def_outcome_regular
cat("\n\n========== DEFENSIVE REGULAR OUTCOME MODEL ==========\n\n")

# Run for def_outcome_starter
```

```{r}
# Conversion Models Plot (2x2 grid)
# Load required libraries
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(ggplot2)

# Function to create a single AUC distribution plot
create_auc_plot <- function(aucs, title) {
  mean_auc <- mean(aucs)
  sd_auc <- sd(aucs)
  ci_lower <- mean_auc - 1.96 * sd_auc
  ci_upper <- mean_auc + 1.96 * sd_auc
  
  # Create data frame for ggplot
  df <- data.frame(
    Iteration = 1:length(aucs),
    AUC = aucs
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Iteration, y = AUC)) +
    geom_point(color = "red", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_auc, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ci_lower, color = "green", linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ci_upper, color = "green", linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("Mean AUC: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f-%.3f)", 
                         mean_auc, ci_lower, ci_upper)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    ylim(min(min(aucs) * 0.99, ci_lower * 0.99), 
         max(max(aucs) * 1.01, ci_upper * 1.01))
  
  return(p)
}

# Load results
results <- readRDS("all_xgboost_results.rds")

# Create plots for conversion models
# Left column: Starter models
off_starter_outcome <- create_auc_plot(
  results$off_outcome_starter$test_aucs,
  "Offensive Starters - Conversion"
)

def_starter_outcome <- create_auc_plot(
  results$def_outcome_starter$test_aucs,
  "Defensive Starters - Conversion"
)

# Right column: On-Field models (regular)
off_onfield_outcome <- create_auc_plot(
  results$off_outcome_regular$test_aucs,
  "Offensive On-Field - Conversion"
)

def_onfield_outcome <- create_auc_plot(
  results$def_outcome_regular$test_aucs,
  "Defensive On-Field - Conversion"
)

# Create row and column titles
top_title <- textGrob(
  "Conversion Prediction Models",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
)

col_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  textGrob("Starter Models", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  textGrob("On-Field Models", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  ncol = 2
)

# Create a corrected legend
legend_data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:3,
  y = rep(1, 3),
  type = c("AUC Values", "Mean", "95% CI Bounds")
)

# Customize the plot for proper legend appearance
legend_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(x=1, y=1), aes(x=x, y=y, color="AUC Values")) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x=c(1,2), y=c(2,2)), aes(x=x, y=y, color="Mean", linetype="Mean")) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x=c(1,2), y=c(3,3)), aes(x=x, y=y, color="95% CI Bounds", linetype="95% CI Bounds")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, 
                     values = c("AUC Values" = "red", 
                                "Mean" = "blue", 
                                "95% CI Bounds" = "green")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL,
                        values = c("Mean" = "dashed",
                                   "95% CI Bounds" = "dotted")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank())

# Extract the legend
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# Arrange the plots in a 2x2 grid
conversion_plots <- arrangeGrob(
  off_starter_outcome, off_onfield_outcome,
  def_starter_outcome, def_onfield_outcome,
  ncol = 2,
  left = textGrob("                 Offense                          Defense", 
                 rot = 90, gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
)

# Combine everything
combined_plot <- grid.arrange(
  top_title,
  col_titles,
  conversion_plots,
  grid::grobTree(legend),
  heights = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.75, 0.1)
)

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  "conversion_models_comparison.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 150
)

# Print confirmation
cat("Conversion models plot saved to conversion_models_comparison.png\n")
```

```{r}
# Selection Models Plot (1x2 grid)
# Load required libraries if not already loaded
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(ggplot2)

# Function to create a single AUC distribution plot
create_auc_plot <- function(aucs, title) {
  mean_auc <- mean(aucs)
  sd_auc <- sd(aucs)
  ci_lower <- mean_auc - 1.96 * sd_auc
  ci_upper <- mean_auc + 1.96 * sd_auc
  
  # Create data frame for ggplot
  df <- data.frame(
    Iteration = 1:length(aucs),
    AUC = aucs
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Iteration, y = AUC)) +
    geom_point(color = "red", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = mean_auc, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ci_lower, color = "green", linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ci_upper, color = "green", linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("Mean AUC: %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f-%.3f)", 
                         mean_auc, ci_lower, ci_upper)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
    ylim(min(min(aucs) * 0.99, ci_lower * 0.99), 
         max(max(aucs) * 1.01, ci_upper * 1.01))
  
  return(p)
}

# Load results if not already loaded
if (!exists("results")) {
  results <- readRDS("all_xgboost_results.rds")
}

# Create plots for attempt selection models
off_select <- create_auc_plot(
  results$off_select_starter$test_aucs,
  "Offensive Starters - Attempt Selection"
)

def_select <- create_auc_plot(
  results$def_select_starter$test_aucs,
  "Defensive Starters - Attempt Selection"
)

# Create titles
top_title <- textGrob(
  "Attempt Selection Models",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
)

col_titles <- arrangeGrob(
  textGrob("Offensive Selection", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  textGrob("Defensive Selection", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)),
  ncol = 2
)

# Create a corrected legend
# Customize the plot for proper legend appearance
legend_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(x=1, y=1), aes(x=x, y=y, color="AUC Values")) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x=c(1,2), y=c(2,2)), aes(x=x, y=y, color="Mean", linetype="Mean")) +
  geom_line(data = data.frame(x=c(1,2), y=c(3,3)), aes(x=x, y=y, color="95% CI Bounds", linetype="95% CI Bounds")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, 
                     values = c("AUC Values" = "red", 
                                "Mean" = "blue", 
                                "95% CI Bounds" = "green")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL,
                        values = c("Mean" = "dashed",
                                   "95% CI Bounds" = "dotted")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.title = element_blank())

# Extract the legend
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

# Arrange the plots in a 1x2 grid
selection_plots <- arrangeGrob(
  off_select, def_select,
  ncol = 2
)

# Combine everything
combined_plot <- grid.arrange(
  top_title,
  col_titles,
  selection_plots,
  grid::grobTree(legend),
  heights = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.75, 0.1)
)

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  "selection_models_comparison.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 150
)

# Print confirmation
cat("Selection models plot saved to selection_models_comparison.png\n")

# Create a summary table for all models
model_summary <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "Offensive Starters - Conversion",
    "Offensive On-Field - Conversion",
    "Defensive Starters - Conversion",
    "Defensive On-Field - Conversion",
    "Offensive Starters - Selection",
    "Defensive Starters - Selection"
  ),
  Mean_AUC = c(
    mean(results$off_outcome_starter$test_aucs),
    mean(results$off_outcome_regular$test_aucs),
    mean(results$def_outcome_starter$test_aucs),
    mean(results$def_outcome_regular$test_aucs),
    mean(results$off_select_starter$test_aucs),
    mean(results$def_select_starter$test_aucs)
  ),
  SD_AUC = c(
    sd(results$off_outcome_starter$test_aucs),
    sd(results$off_outcome_regular$test_aucs),
    sd(results$def_outcome_starter$test_aucs),
    sd(results$def_outcome_regular$test_aucs),
    sd(results$off_select_starter$test_aucs),
    sd(results$def_select_starter$test_aucs)
  )
)

# Calculate 95% CI
model_summary$CI_Lower <- model_summary$Mean_AUC - 1.96 * model_summary$SD_AUC
model_summary$CI_Upper <- model_summary$Mean_AUC + 1.96 * model_summary$SD_AUC

# Print table
print(model_summary)

# Save summary table
write.csv(model_summary, "model_performance_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
